title: Covering Squares with Sumsets
exact_target: Must a set whose pairwise sums contain every one of the first n positive squares have cardinality nearly n on the exponent scale?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 122 (GREEN-034). CC BY 4.0.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, maintained author collection, Problem 61 and its comments, accessed 7 October 2026.
